description: This file is documentation for the 'WebError' class in the Playwright API, including language-specific code examples demonstrating how to handle web errors in different programming languages.

classes.name: WebError
classes.description: Represents an unhandled exception thrown in the page, dispatched via the 'BrowserContext.webError' event.

methods.name: WebError.page
methods.description: Returns the page that produced this unhandled exception, if any.

methods.name: WebError.error
methods.description: Returns the unhandled error that was thrown. In some languages, returns a string; in others, a JavaScript Error object.
